selection_method: literature global meeting shortlist -> evidence enrichment -> real-sequence audit -> constrained 1 balanced + 2 imbalanced optimization

meeting_shortlist.deduplication_evidence: Sequence deduplication, length filtering, negative set audit for non-AMP peptides.
meeting_shortlist.description: Potential balanced set for baseline testing; ABP-Finder used it for antibacterial sub-classification, may be adapted for general AMP with proper negative set.

meeting_shortlist.deduplication_evidence: Verify deduplication, check for sequence homology with other benchmark sets, confirm negative set composition.
meeting_shortlist.description: Explicitly balanced dataset with known positive and negative counts; can serve as a benchmark for balanced performance.

meeting_shortlist.dataset_role: imbalanced (negative set to be constructed from non-AMP sequences)
meeting_shortlist.deduplication_evidence: Define binary negative set, perform CD-HIT clustering, balance prevalence.
meeting_shortlist.description: Large AMP set; constructing a severe imbalanced set (e.g., 1:100) from dbAMP positives and random non-AMP negatives could test robustness.

empirically_evaluated_top3.canonical_name: veltri damp amp scanner v2 original
empirically_evaluated_top3.deduplication_evidence: Original publication reports <=40% pairwise sequence identity for the curated dataset; rerun the current benchmark homology gate.
empirically_evaluated_top3.description: APIN reused the Veltri/DAMP split; APIN benchmarking set is therefore an alias/usage relationship, not a separate dataset.
empirically_evaluated_top3.length_evidence: The full 1,778 + 1,778 dataset has mean length about 34 aa; the exact 10-50 aa fraction must be measured after download.
empirically_evaluated_top3.independence_scope: Not an independent external test for AMP Scanner v2, APIN/APIN-fusion, AMP-BERT, ACEP or any model trained/tuned on the Veltri split. It may be used for other models only after training-overlap audit.
empirically_evaluated_top3.evaluation_scope: Empirically evaluated candidate; model-specific training overlap and homology audits remain mandatory.

empirically_evaluated_top3.canonical_name: c amps predict under 50 aa test and data
empirically_evaluated_top3.description: The repository contains explicit AMP and non-AMP FASTA files, but sample counts, negative construction and split identity must be audited before selection.
empirically_evaluated_top3.length_evidence: Official repository describes the test data as under 50 aa; minimum length and the exact 10-50 aa fraction must be measured.
empirically_evaluated_top3.independence_scope: Model-associated data cannot be used as an independent test for C_AMPs-predict. It can nominate short-peptide sequences for other models only after provenance and training-overlap audits.
empirically_evaluated_top3.evaluation_scope: Empirically evaluated candidate; model-specific training overlap and homology audits remain mandatory.

empirically_evaluated_top3.description: Zenodo explicitly documents separate AMPSorter test, benchmarking and external-validation worksheets; the agent must enumerate workbook sheets rather than treating the DOI as one opaque dataset.
empirically_evaluated_top3.independence_scope: The AMPSorter test/benchmark sheets are model-associated and cannot be called independent for AMPSorter without reconstructing their relationship to training. The external-validation sheet is the preferred extraction target, still subject to overlap audit.
empirically_evaluated_top3.evaluation_scope: Empirically evaluated candidate; model-specific training overlap and homology audits remain mandatory.

acquisition_queue.dataset_role: negative-sampling robustness and external benchmark candidate
acquisition_queue.deduplication_evidence: Positive data were split before negative sampling to reduce leakage; rerun exact and <=40% identity audits locally.
acquisition_queue.description: Useful as a stress-test family rather than a single opaque test set; preserves multiple negative-construction scenarios and replications.
acquisition_queue.length_evidence: Negative sampling strategies include length-matched variants; exact 10-50 aa coverage must be measured on the selected replication.
acquisition_queue.independence_scope: Preferred robustness candidate because it exposes negative-set bias, but independence is model-specific and must be established against training references.

acquisition_queue.description: Adds a naturally imbalanced recent candidate, but its size does not override the length, provenance and leakage gates.
acquisition_queue.length_evidence: not_reported_in_verified_snapshot; must pass the project 10-50 aa coverage gate after download.
acquisition_queue.independence_scope: Not independent for MAPLE and derived partly from iAMPCN/public AMP resources; use for other models only after cross-database label and homology audit.

acquisition_queue.positive_samples_evidence: AMPs with activity below threshold; numbers not explicitly given

acquisition_queue.deduplication_evidence: CdHit (80% sequence similarity, resulting in 109,678 clusters)

acquisition_queue.negative_samples_evidence: Not explicitly mentioned; MIC values used as regression target

acquisition_queue.split_method: train/test split (770 AMPs training, 920 AMPs test)
